name: Bauh
description: No hash/sig for AppImage/NodeJS/Electron payloads; HttpClient.exists() hardcodes verify=False; a global toggle can disable TLS validation app-wide (injects axel -k).
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Bauh compares available release versions and passes configured transport settings to its HTTP client. The full artifact-authentication policy remains unestablished.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release; external gem/framework verification and released artifact signing were not independently audited.

fields.label: has_updater
fields.value: Y (self — checks GitHub Releases API on startup/interval and shows a text notification; does not download/replace itself)

fields.label: auto
fields.value: N (notification only — user must click the release link and update manually/via their package manager)

fields.label: downloads_and_executes
fields.value: N for self-update. Y for the AppImage gem: downloads the .AppImage binary from a per-app `url_download`, `chmod a+x`s it, and runs `--appimage-extract` / launches it, with no hash or signature check anywhere in the gem

fields.label: transport
fields.value: https — `api.github.com` (self-update check), `raw.githubusercontent.com/vinifmor/bauh-files` (curated AppImage catalog "database"), and arbitrary per-app `url_download` for the actual AppImage binaries

fields.label: manifest_signed
fields.value: N — self-update check has no signing (plain JSON API + tag-name string compare); the bauh-files AppImage catalog is plain HTTPS with no detached signature found

fields.label: payload_verification
fields.value: none — self-update is a version-string comparison only, no payload fetched; AppImage gem has no sha256/gpg/checksum/verify hit anywhere in `bauh/gems/appimage/*.py` before the file is chmod +x'd and executed

fields.label: evidence
fields.value: bauh/view/core/update.py:22-24,38-48 (`http_client.get_json('https://api.github.com/repos/vinifmor/bauh/releases')`, tag-name compare, notify-only — no download call); bauh/gems/appimage/__init__.py:16 (`URL_COMPRESSED_DATABASES = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vinifmor/bauh-files/master/appimage/dbs.tar.gz'`); bauh/gems/appimage/controller.py:626-660 (`chmod a+x`, `--appimage-extract`, no hash/sig check in `install`/`_install`); zero hits for `sha256\|gpg\|signature\|verify\|checksum` in `bauh/gems/appimage/*.py`

fields.label: transport
fields.value: HTTPS by default; `HttpClient.exists()` **hardcodes `verify=False`** (`bauh/api/http.py:109-121`); user-configurable `download.check_ssl` (default True) can globally disable TLS validation for every download, incl. appending axel's `-k` flag (`bauh/view/core/downloader.py:153-158`)

fields.label: payload_verification
fields.value: **None** for AppImage binaries (no hash/sig check anywhere in `bauh/gems/appimage/*.py`); NodeJS tarball extracted with zero checksum (`environment.py:52-96`); "sha256" field for Electron is actually just a boolean cache-hit flag, never a real digest compare (`environment.py:196-219`)
